Job Description Summary 
At GE HealthCare, we are advancing precision care by creating technologies that make a meaningful difference for clinicians and patients. We are building the next generation of intelligent, connected MRI workflows—and we’re looking for thoughtful, collaborative engineers who are excited to grow with us.

As a Software Engineer, you will help evolve a mission‑critical MRI software platform built on a modern, microservices‑based architecture. Your work will contribute directly to improving patient experiences and enabling clinicians to deliver high‑quality care.

This role supports SIGNA™ One, our AI‑driven workflow platform designed to simplify MRI—from planning and setup through scanning and beyond. SIGNA One enables faster scans, reduces complexity, and promotes a patient‑first experience through intelligent automation.

In this role, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of software components within a defined product area. You’ll collaborate closely with experienced engineers, product partners, and cross‑functional teams, while continuing to build your technical skills and deepen your understanding of complex systems. We value learning, mentorship, and diverse perspectives, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification. 
 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Participate in technical discussions and design sessions, contributing ideas and learning from peers
 Help translate product requirements into practical technical solutions for assigned components
 Build and grow your understanding of assigned modules, including dependencies and data flows
 Develop features, enhancements, and bug fixes aligned with established architecture and coding practices
 Support implementation of interfaces and data exchange between system components
 Apply standard testing practices, including unit and integration testing, to ensure code quality
 Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback to strengthen solutions and team collaboration
 Identify and address routine performance or reliability issues within your scope of work
 Collaborate with Product Line Leaders and cross‑functional partners to clarify requirements and deliver outcomes
 Contribute to documentation and team knowledge sharing to support collective success
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field
 At least 2 years of experience in software development
 Experience with frontend development (Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
 Familiarity with Java/JEE, Spring Boot or Spring frameworks, and API tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience building software on Windows and/or Unix/Linux environments
 Exposure to modern development and CI/CD tools (e.g., Git, Docker, Jenkins, Gradle/Maven, BDD/Cucumber, Artifactory)
 

 
 #LI-VS1
 #LI-Onsite
 #LI-CC1
 
 
 
 
 
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

 
 
 Additional Information 
 GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an  Equal Opportunity Employer . Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 
 







 
 
 GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). 
 







 
 
 While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.
 
 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No
